name: @useyolo/metadata-local
description: Official Yolo metadata plugin: describes files from what lies beside them and inside them: Kodi-style NFO files, posters and fan art, cast pictures, embedded tags, and the file name

summary.en: Names and posters from what lies beside your files: NFO files, posters, and embedded tags.
summary.zh: 从文件旁边的内容读取名称和海报：NFO 文件、海报和内嵌标签。

privacy.en: Reads files on the home machine. Sends nothing.
privacy.zh: 只读取家里电脑上的文件，不发送任何东西。
